abilities.name: Untouchable
abilities.description: Once between rests, at the start of a round, you may spend 10 Hope. If you do, your partner Digimon negates all damage and effects that would be applied to them this round. Your Digimon cannot attack during a round you use this ability.

abilities.name: Gentle Toll
abilities.description: Untouchable's cost is reduced from 10 Hope to 4 Hope.

abilities.name: Ready Again
abilities.description: Untouchable is no longer limited to once between rests. You may use it once per encounter instead.

abilities.name: Fed by Light
abilities.description: Whenever your partner Digimon takes damage from a Light attack, you may gain 8 Hope.

abilities.name: No Sacrifice
abilities.description: Your Digimon can now attack normally during a round you use Untouchable.

abilities.name: Never Go Dark
abilities.description: Once per encounter, when your partner Digimon would dark digivolve, you may instead spend Hope equal to the full Hope cost of their current stage. If you do, the dark digivolution is prevented and they hold their current stage normally.
